e811793035645ca269968ada569f550ece9d4ad7.sourceText: 例如：障碍有离地20 cm的有效回波，可能进入输出；若它只有离地1.2 m处的回波，而“地面高度”选得正确，这些回波会被本项删掉。调小可能漏掉部分障碍，调大可能把悬空横梁等结构引入结果。应结合真实车辆需要避让的高度、雷达能看见的部位和地面估计核对，不能直接把名字当整车高度填入。
e811793035645ca269968ada569f550ece9d4ad7.translatedText: For example: if an obstacle has a valid echo at 20 cm above the ground, it may enter the output; if it only has an echo at 1\.2 m above the ground, and the "ground height" is selected correctly, these echoes will be removed by this item\. Reducing it may miss some obstacles, while increasing it may introduce structures such as suspended beams into the result\. It should be checked against the height that the real vehicle needs to avoid, the parts that the radar can see, and the ground estimate; the name must not be directly filled in as the vehicle height\.

e82aa9fbfcc669bed56c70b96fc3f8a7a48c9a1e.translatedText: The reason is:`swap_demo::swap` It is originally an ordinary C++ function, and we want it to preserve the namespace notation of C++\.`extern "C"` It should only be placed on the layer of interface that the C code actually needs to call, that is, the preceding `cpp_interface.h` in the `cpp_main(void)`\.
